record.paper_title: Effective non-linear dynamics of binary condensates and open problems
record.original_question: For a one-component Bose gas, can one rigorously derive the Gross-Pitaevskii equation i∂_t u_t = -∆u_t + 8πa|u_t|^2u_t from the many-body quantum dynamics in the Gross-Pitaevskii scaling?

evidence.quote: The one-component problem, namely the derivation of the Gross-Pitaevskii equation i∂tut = −∆ut +8πa|ut|2ut, has been an important open problem in mathematical physics in recent years. It was first solved by Erd"os, Schlein and Yau in 2006 (see [4] and [5]); their proof was based on the BBGKY formalism and did not provide a convergence rate.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider a system of $N$ identical spinless bosons in $\mathbb{R}^3$ governed by the Hamiltonian
$$H_N = \sum_{j=1}^N (-\Delta_{x_j}) + \sum_{1\le i<j\le N} N^2 V(N(x_i-x_j)),$$
acting on the symmetric subspace of $L^2(\mathbb{R}^{3N})$, where $V\ge 0$ is a smooth, compactly supported, spherically symmetric potential with three-dimensional scattering length $a$. Let $\Psi_{N,t} = e^{-iH_N t}\Psi_{N,0}$ be the solution of the many-body Schrödinger equation, with initial data $\Psi_{N,0}$ exhibiting complete Bose-Einstein condensation in a one-particle state $\varphi\in H^1(\mathbb{R}^3)$ (i.e., the one-particle reduced density matrix $\gamma_{N,0}^{(1)}\to |\varphi\rangle\langle\varphi|$ in trace norm as $N\to\infty$).

Prove that for every fixed $t\in\mathbb{R}$, the one-particle reduced density matrix $\gamma_{N,t}^{(1)}$ associated with $\Psi_{N,t}$ converges in trace norm, as $N\to\infty$, to $|u_t\rangle\langle u_t|$, where $u_t$ solves the cubic nonlinear Gross-Pitaevskii equation
$$i\partial_t u_t = -\Delta u_t + 8\pi a\, |u_t|^2 u_t,\qquad u_0=\varphi.$$
artifact.status_search_result: The derivation of the time-dependent Gross-Pitaevskii equation from many-body bosonic quantum dynamics in the GP scaling was solved by Erdős, Schlein and Yau (Comm. Pure Appl. Math. 2006; Invent. Math. 2007; Ann. of Math. 2010) using the BBGKY hierarchy. Subsequent works (Pickl; Benedikter–de Oliveira–Schlein; Brennecke–Schlein, etc.) provided alternative proofs and quantitative convergence rates.

status_evidence.title: Derivation of the cubic non-linear Schrödinger equation from quantum dynamics of many-body systems
status_evidence.snippet: Erdős, Schlein, Yau prove convergence of reduced density matrices to solutions of the GP equation in the Gross-Pitaevskii scaling.
status_evidence.claim: The one-component GP derivation was first established by Erdős, Schlein, Yau.

status_evidence.title: Derivation of the Gross-Pitaevskii equation for the dynamics of Bose-Einstein condensate
